name: North Hunt
detailed_description:
🌨️ North Hunt – The Ascended West Hunt

Step into the frostbitten lands of the North, where the snow hides more than just footprints. North Hunt is the spiritual successor and bold evolution of West Hunt ,reimagined in a brutal Viking-era world, packed with refined gameplay, expanded roles, and a mission system built from the ground up.

🔥 What’s New in North Hunt?

⚔️ Massive Character Movement Upgrade

Experience smoother, more dynamic movement and animations, bringing stealth, chases, and deception to life like never before.

🎯 Advanced Mission System

Missions are no longer simple tasks — they’re multi-step objectives tied to strategy and timing. Whether you’re an outlaw sowing chaos or a chief restoring order, your path is now deeper and more interactive.

🧠 Expanded Roles & Abilities

North Hunt introduces a wide variety of new roles for both Outlaws and Chiefs, each with unique abilities, strengths, and challenges. These new roles add layers of social deception, teamwork, and mind games.

🧊 A Nordic World Full of Secrets

Explore a rugged Viking settlement where snowy forests, ancient ruins, and bustling markets provide the backdrop for cat-and-mouse gameplay. NPC behaviors, environment cues, and player actions blend into a rich, immersive hunt.

🛡️ A True Evolution of West Hunt

This is not just a sequel — North Hunt is an ascended version of West Hunt, built with community feedback, years of iteration, and a commitment to deeper, more strategic multiplayer deception.

👀 Coming Soon…

More gameplay mechanics, modes, and twists are in the works and will be revealed over time. Prepare to discover secrets that will change the way you hunt or hide.

short_description: North Hunt is a Viking-era stealth and deception game where you must blend in, complete objectives, and avoid detection in living Norse villages, Sequel of West Hunt, North Hunt gives a lot of new features compared to the first one.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Arabic, Dutch, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support
